eligibility: complete connected nonreference protein classes, codon residual dimensions>=3; quarantine entire VP central-AA stratum
protein_grouping_scope: local AA157/158 strata, not independent genes or protein families; all share309of313residues
normalization: within-class mean centering for whole-field diagnostics; categorical four-codon projector includes intercept; no shared reference anchor
codon_projector: P f=sum_j E[f|codon_j]-3 E[f]; Q=I-P, uniform over each complete codon Cartesian product
primary_endpoint: class-size-weighted pooled cosine between Q T and Q V: sum_g <QTg,QVg>/n_g divided by sqrt(sum_g ||QTg||^2/n_g * sum_g ||QVg||^2/n_g)
primary_target_interpretation: predeclared operational target, not statistical significance or calibrated biological threshold
null_energy_rule: if either pooled residual energy is zero, primary endpoint undefined and design uninformative; no classwise zero-energy exclusion
main_effect_and_residual_df: p_g=1+sum_j(s_gj-1); q_g=n_g-p_g; ranks and q recorded per class, q>=3 is algebraic dimension not biological-error df
comparators: fixed QT as predictor of QV versus zero residual; secondary loss, no fitted shrinkage
secondary_endpoints: RNA-only and DNA-only residual cosine for each of3librarypairs
per-class raw RNA rank agreement for each3librarypairs; midranks and undefined ties recorded
whole-field centered T versus V cosine and fixed T prediction loss
classwise signed residual cosine, energies, and RMSE; keep zero-denominator cases
fixed unshrunk residual prediction error versus zero-residual baseline
maximum endpoint-relative barrier across all pairs on selected connected graphs, separately for clique-product and nonclique-factor classes; compare fitted codon-additive fields

normalization_decomposition.all_scenarios: 3RNA x3DNA, including ordinal-aligned illustration; no biological pairing assumed
normalization_decomposition.pairs: all45 unordered scenario pairs including9diagonals, plus primary averaged-training versus validation pair
normalization_decomposition.reporting: four signed terms and total per class, and aggregate with1/n_g weights; numerical identity residual must be scale-aware tiny
normalization_decomposition.interpretation: deterministic identity; no causal attribution fraction, independence assumption, or noise ceiling
